ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels and 15% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central lobes; dark peripheral banding along leading and trailing edges; vertical dark linear pigmentation extending from the median notch downward; multiple small dark focal spots distributed on the upper quadrant of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the interior lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and variable-amplitude serrations extracted along the continuous linear boundary; irregular peak-to-valley variations most prominent at the distal tips; high contrast against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edges, tapering to sharp points at the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular dark pixel clusters consistent with scar tissue or barnacle attachment sites, predominantly located on the upper white surfaces of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across the white ventral surface, including a series of parallel lines on the lower central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and heavy serration along the trailing edges; prominent dark vertical scarring near the median notch; numerous localized linear rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive dark vertical pigmentation streak bisecting the lower central region, extending from the median notch vertex.
